reports.title: Kemper Reports Third Quarter 2026 Operating Results*

desk.headline: Back in profit: adjusted EPS $1.01 vs $0.33, beat; revenue down 12% to $1.09bn as personal auto shrinks; no guidance
results: Kemper earned $52.4m ($0.88 a share), against a $21.0m loss a year ago; adjusted EPS of $1.01 beat the $0.78 estimate.
Revenue fell 12% to $1.09bn as personal auto premiums dropped 24% after rate and underwriting actions; commercial auto grew 11%.
The P&C combined ratio improved to 99.2%, helped by $23.2m of favourable prior-year reserve development; before that, the underlying ratio worsened to 101.7%.
In California personal auto, the combined ratio fell to 98.2% from 110.6% in Q1 2026.
Book value per share fell 21% to $36.20 since year-end, after a Q2 goodwill write-down and bond-value losses; the $0.32 quarterly dividend was kept.

guidance.summary: Kemper gives no financial guidance. The release says it will keep looking for efficiency gains through 2027.

watch: Whether the underlying combined ratio falls below 100% without help from reserve releases.
Personal auto premium trends as California rate increases earn in.
Commercial auto claim severity and book value recovery.
